name: TorrServer STRM Manager
description: Add magnet links through TorrServer and generate Jellyfin-compatible .strm files for movies and series. Titles, years, types, and libraries are detected automatically. The plugin repairs .strm addresses, re-adds missing torrents, and removes torrents from TorrServer when their media is deleted.
overview: Import magnet links into Jellyfin as .strm files via TorrServer.

versions.changelog: Initial release with magnet import, automatic metadata detection, series layout, .strm repair, tracked files, and automatic TorrServer cleanup.
